description: Edit a scheduled event's details, or move it through its lifecycle: status start makes it live, status end completes it. An ended event cannot be started again, so ending one needs confirming: the first call changes nothing and returns a preview and a confirm_token, and repeating the call with the token makes the change. Everything else happens at once.

confirm_token.description: The token from this exact action's preview. Where the app can show a confirmation dialog, calling with it asks the user there, and it happens only if they agree.

guild.description: Guild (server) name or ID. Omit to use the default guild.

name: update_event
title: Update event
